post.title: IC_K ≠ inf IC: When the Infimum Destroys the Answer
post.subtitle: Why optimizing over distributions kills your lower bound

promotional.twitter_thread: 1/ IC_K (Kolmogorov worst-case information complexity) and inf IC (Shannon distribution-free infimum) look like the same concept. They're not. One says Equality needs Θ(log n) communication. The other says 0. For EVERY Boolean function. Thread on why this matters:
promotional.linkedin_summary: New blog post: IC_K ≠ inf IC. The infimum over distributions collapses Shannon information complexity to zero for all Boolean functions, while Kolmogorov-based IC_K gives meaningful worst-case bounds. The quantifier order and complexity measure determine what question you're actually asking.
